prompt_action_order: deterministic per episode/step, identical to diagnostic B
evaluation_memory: Separate initially empty memory per direction, task order then 5 repeats; persist between tasks
cohort: Exact historical adaptation valid_seen 74 games: 20 kitchen, 14 living_room, 20 bathroom, 20 bedroom

cohort_reference.reason: User requested exact task alignment with completed same-vs-cross environment experiment; task IDs and order, not only counts

evaluation_outcome_policy: Outcomes used only for evaluator termination and reporting; never policy, tracker, judge or memory.
memory_policy: New empty memory per room; original task order and five consecutive repeats; judge score / 10 only, gamma=.95; exploration settings unchanged; no success bonus or failure penalty. Retrieval = WebArena upstream k=3; advantage normalization = paper Eq. 25 (eq25_logit); nothing else changed.

retrieval.history_text: normalized actions so far in the episode
retrieval.deviation: top-k cut applied (upstream has [:k] commented out; offline replay: 83 neighbours/step without it)

normalization.replaces: A / max positive A over all retrieved actions (code)
